relevance.rationale: Genuine orphan; a doctoral thesis on Laplacian eigenvalue multiplicities of constant-negative-curvature surfaces with large symmetry groups, treating the Bolza surface (genus 2, automorphism group GL_2(Z_3) semidirect Z_2) and the Klein quartic (genus 3, PGL_2(Z_7) semidirect Z_2), proving mult(lambda_1) = 3 and mult(lambda_2) = 4 for Bolza and mult(lambda_1) in {6,7,8} for the Klein quartic, with numerical eigenvalue appendices for those surfaces and the Fermat quartic. The folio's central object is a genus-4 surface with automorphism group S_5 — the exact next member of that family — and folio/quantum-observable-universe/brings-surface/hyperelliptic-quintic.md already places a folio surface 'in the Bolza family' citing bolza1887. So the METHOD (decompose L^2 of the surface into irreducibles of the automorphism group, then bound eigenvalue multiplicities representation-theoretically) transfers directly. Honest limits: the thesis does NOT treat the genus-4 case, the Bolza lambda_1 result is stated as conditional on a further conjecture with numerical evidence, and — the reason this is not core — grep finds no folio claim about a Laplacian spectral gap or first eigenvalue on its surface for the method to serve. It is a technique source with no current consumer.

keyResults.statement: Representation-theoretic decomposition under the full automorphism group determines Laplacian eigenvalue multiplicities on maximally symmetric hyperbolic surfaces: multiplicity 3 for lambda_1 and 4 for lambda_2 on the Bolza surface (the lambda_1 result conditional on a stated conjecture supported numerically).
keyResults.useForFolio: The transferable method for any future folio claim about the Laplacian spectrum of its genus-4 S_5-symmetric surface; the numerical appendices give reference eigenvalues for the neighbouring genus-2 and genus-3 cases.

proposedActions.rationale: No ref() entry; the folio already cites the 19th-century Bolza source and works the same surface family one genus up, so the modern spectral treatment is the natural companion.

Worth recording that the automorphism-irrep method extends in principle to the folio's genus-4 S_5 surface — and, equally, that the folio currently makes no eigenvalue-multiplicity claim there, so this is an available technique rather than a gap being closed.
